correctness.rationale: The local (left,right) wall transfer is verified case by case. A/B swap wires imply two oppositely moving particle species and collisions strictly destroy mixed pairs; opposite nonzero spatial winding forces a collision within finitely many sweeps. Once one species vanishes, contracted blocks shift cyclically and all points there are periodic. Inclusion-exclusion and Möbius inversion yield exact all-d orbit counts; Eulerian counting and the dominant pole at log 2 yield the order expectation. The delivered standalone C++ exhausts all 46,230 permutations through n=8 and the Python checker independently corroborates wall extinction and sector rotation on exact finite domains.

value.rationale: Arbitrary permutation scans of the same natural graph and same hysteretic threshold rule range from two sector lengths 1 and n-1 to two comparable lengths, changing the period spectrum and recurrent-state count. The entire exact period distribution, two-sector invariant geometry and exponentially small schedule-average recurrent fraction provide structurally motivated and nontrivial quantification of update-order sensitivity. This is not a small fixed-size census or a mere parameter relabeling.
